note: Research default posting times, used only when Metricool has no best-time data for the brand (getBestTimeToPostByNetwork). Every list is in strict priority order, highest engagement first, in the audience's local time (US audience: America/New_York). days = primary hours per weekday; backup = the next-best hours the same studies name for that weekday; acceptable_curve = every hour 07:00-22:00 ranked by the overall Facebook engagement curve of those studies, the third tier (each day takes the hours not already primary or backup, in curve order). See docs/metricool.md, 'Giờ đăng'.

sources.name: Sprout Social, Best times to post on Facebook (data Nov 27, 2025 to Feb 27, 2026, ~2 billion engagements, ~307,000 profiles, local time)
